subject: Won the dispute but still got charged a fee?
body: Quick question - we won a dispute recently (disp_14_01) and I can see the transaction amount was returned to us in yesterday's payout, which is great. But I also noticed a separate 500 rupee deduction in the same batch that I'm assuming is a chargeback fee for the same case. If we won, shouldn't that fee also be reversed? Seems odd to still be penalized for a dispute that was resolved in our favor. Can you confirm whether this is correct or an error.
